summary.text: Heather Sample is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 67, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
A paralegal, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has served as chair of the Ashland County Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Heather Sample's career experience includes working as a paralegal, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Sample described herself as a lifelong advocate for working families and said she has served as Chair of the Ashland County Democratic Party.

Sample said in the survey that her campaign emphasizes fully funding public education, supporting teachers and school staff, and lowering everyday costs such as housing, groceries, healthcare and utilities.
She listed a woman's right to choose, recreational and medical cannabis use, gun violence, public education and healthcare among the policy areas she is passionate about.
